company.description: The company whose point of view this is; stances are written as 'we'.

own_domains.description: The company's own domains. A page read by an earlier step counts as the company's writing only on one of these domains or a subdomain.

notes.description: Optional pasted founder notes or a conversation transcript: the founders' own words, cited as input:notes.

focus_topics.description: Topics the company wants a stance on; used only to find gaps, which become questions.

max_new.description: The most new and revised stances to propose in one run.

max_library.description: The most active stances (approved plus waiting) the library should hold.

now.description: Current time, ISO 8601, written to updated_at. Optional: on JoyStream bind it to the run start time. Never guessed.

slack_brief.description: When true, also return `slack`: the review brief as one Slack message with a card per stance.

library_link.description: Optional address of the library sheet, linked from the Slack brief.

brief_footer.description: Optional closing line for the Slack brief.
